shortDesc.message: Automated typing and DOM keystroke simulator for security testing and bypassing restricted paste fields across modern browsers.

storeDesc.message: GhostType - GTekSD automates text entry in supported browser form fields using synthetic DOM events. Save multiple snippets, adjust typing speed, and optionally simulate pauses and corrections. Websites can reject synthetic input; this extension does not bypass paste restrictions or site security controls. Compatibility varies by browser, website, and editor.
